description_sentence: Draws a seeded synthetic sample and reports count, mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and an ASCII histogram.
failure_note: An empty sample cannot occur (n comes from --samples), and a constant sample degrades gracefully to a single non-empty histogram bin.

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} statistical analyzer in pure Python computing mean, median, stdev, quartiles, and histograms from seeded synthetic data; prints a formatted report with an ASCII distribution plot.
scaling_note: The sample is sorted in memory, so multi-million-point samples would need a streaming quantile sketch instead.
storage_note: In-memory only: the sample and summary exist for the duration of the run and nothing is persisted.
tradeoff_note: Hand-rolled statistics avoid dependencies but only cover univariate descriptives, not hypothesis tests or modeling.
